statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary
The service is to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The service is to correlate arrhythmias with documented symptoms
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
